name: Stadium LED billboard
doc: Displays the input media on a colossal modular stadium LED wall with discrete RGB diode subpixels, sweeping refresh scanlines, steel truss spill lighting, and failing/rebooting LED cabinet modules on onsets.

luma.doc: media brightness mask (core-media.luma) for diode intensity and scan highlights

edges.doc: media edge gradient (core-media.edges) for electric neon contour highlights

palette.doc: concert accent palette for edge highlights, scan shimmer, and rebooting panels

rows.doc: vertical LED diode density across the billboard

frame.doc: stadium truss gantry border margin around the wall

dropout.doc: dropped, torn, and rebooting LED cabinet modules on onsets

edge_glow.doc: electric palette highlight along media edges on bass hits

glow.doc: overall LED diode luminance and lens bloom
